_meta.description: Baseline-4 final measurement — the committed BEFORE column for the Phase-16 baseline-5 close record (Task 16.17). Captured on the committed baseline-4 replay bytes immediately before the baseline-5 re-record replaced them; the baseline-4 bytes themselves survive only in git history at the commit named below. The close audit regenerates its BEFORE column from this file — no hand-computed figures. Extends the baseline3-final-measure.json convention with the 'vj' block: the Task-16.10 V&J instruments exist at this capture (they did not at the baseline-3 capture), and the close's before/after on those instruments must regenerate from a committed artifact.
